failure.title: Evidence validation rejected valid digit-bearing requirement families
failure.note: The retained independent ledger review and exact pre-fix expression show that release evidence would reject legitimate digit-bearing requirement families already mapped by the defect history, including QA-E2E-011 and QA-A11Y-005.
failure.diagnosis: The defect-history verifier allowed uppercase letters only in intermediate requirement-ID segments, while the canonical inventory includes alphanumeric families such as E2E and A11Y. The validator was therefore narrower than the identifiers it was responsible for checking.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
